headline: Tokyo and Seoul Stocks Fall; Anthropic's Successful Debut Does Not Dispel Fears About AI
summary: Asian markets followed a weak Wall Street session, with Tokyo and Seoul stocks falling. Investors remain wary of AI valuations despite Anthropic's successful debut.
why: Tokyo and Seoul are home to the Nikkei 225 and KOSPI, benchmarks for Japanese and South Korean equities, many of which are linked to global technology supply chains.
why_moved: Asian shares followed a lower New York close, where investors showed little interest in most stocks. Doubts about artificial intelligence valuations weighed on sentiment.
original_headline: Bolsas de Tokio y Seúl caen; el exitoso debut de Anthropic no disipa los temores sobre la IA
